# Neybras Magazine

> Premium B2B magazine (print and digital) based in Casablanca, Morocco, published in French. Legal and financial analysis for business decision-makers in Morocco and French-speaking Africa.

## Type & Format

- Publisher: Neybras Publishing, Casablanca (Morocco)
- Periodicity: 4 issues per year (quarterly)
- Print circulation: 1,000 copies (controlled, nominative distribution)
- Pagination: 24 pages
- First print issue: Vol. 001, September 2026
- Language: French

## Core Expertise & Themes

Neybras Magazine provides legal and financial analysis for C-level executives, general counsels, business lawyers, CFOs and investors in Morocco and French-speaking Africa. It breaks down regulatory changes into information usable for decisions. Signed contributions (analyses, opinion pieces, interviews) are published with the author's name and role.

Key coverage areas:

- Moroccan business law and case law
- Corporate finance, taxation and investment incentives (for example Framework Law 03-22 and the Investment Charter)
- Infrastructure projects, public-private partnerships and international arbitration
- Investments in Sub-Saharan Africa and the OHADA zone
- Sport business and the transformation of sports clubs
- Artificial intelligence and legal tech
